compilation.title_en: Kitāb al-Zuhd of Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī
compilation.edition: Dār Aṭlas for Publishing and Distribution, Riyadh, 1st ed., 1421 AH / 2000 CE
compilation.description_en: The Book of Asceticism of Abū Ḥātim Muḥammad ibn Idrīs al-Rāzī (d. 277 AH): 105 numbered reports on renunciation, most of them sayings of Companions, Successors and early ascetics.

notes.label: Edition
notes.text: Dār Aṭlas for Publishing and Distribution, Riyadh, 1st ed., 1421 AH / 2000 CE

notes.label: Structure
notes.text: An undivided book of numbered reports. It opens with the chain through which the copy was transmitted, which the source spreads over its first pages and which stands once before the reports. Where one printed number covers a second chain or a further passage, each is its own entry under the same number.

notes.label: English translation
notes.text: The English is the supplied translation, which follows the source record by record. Notes that the translation attaches to a report appear beneath it, apart from the Arabic and English text.

notes.label: Arabic text
notes.text: The Arabic is the text of the source page records, shown as supplied. A report’s printed number stands in its label instead of the text, and page markers are carried over from the source.

notes.label: Isnad and matn
notes.text: The English chain and words are divided as the translation gives them. The Arabic is divided at the same point by a fixed rule that does not alter the text; where the rule finds no clean division, the Arabic is shown whole.

notes.label: Transmitters
notes.text: Transmission paths list the names the translation gives for each chain, in English only. No transmitter is identified beyond the wording of the source.

notes.label: Dating
notes.text: The date shown is the death year of Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī, 277 AH, not a verified date of composition.

notes.label: Coverage
notes.text: 123 entries in 1 section, in the source order.

frames_before.en: The shaykh Abū Ṭāhir Muḥammad b. al-Ḥusayn b. Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm al-Ḥannāʾī informed us, by my reading to him; he said: The judge Abū al-Ḥasan ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Abī al-Qāsim ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Aḥmad al-Ḥubbārī informed us, by reading [to him] while I listened, in Ṣafar of the year four hundred and forty-three [AH]; he said: My father informed me, by my reading to him in al-Muḥarram of the year ninety-three and three hundred [AH]; he said: Abū al-Ḥasan ʿAlī b. Ibrāhīm b. Salama al-Qaṭṭān informed us, by reading to him; he said:
frames_before.ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الشَّيْخُ أَبُو طَاهِرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنَّائِيُّ بِقِرَاءَتِي عَلَيْهِ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا الْقَاضِي أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي الْقَاسِمِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بِنْ أَحْمَدَ الْحُبَّارِيُّ قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ، وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُ فِي صَفَرٍ مِنْ سَنَةِ ثَلَاثٍ وَأَرْبَعِينَ وَأَرْبَعِمِائَةٍ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنِي وَالِدِي بِقِرَاءَتِي عَلَيْهِ فِي الْمُحَرَّمِ سَنَةَ ثَلَاثٍ وَتِسْعِينَ وَثَلَاثِمِائَةٍ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ الْقَطَّانُ قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ ، قَالَ:

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ الرَّازِيُّ قَالَ: ⦗ص: 30⦘ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ:
records.matn_ar: "‌ ‌ إِنَّكُمْ لَمُغْفِلُونَ أَفْضَلَ الْعِبَادَةِ: التَّوَاضُعَ "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim Muḥammad b. Idrīs al-Ḥanẓalī al-Rāzī narrated to us. He said: [p. 30] Abū Nuʿaym narrated to us. He said: Misʿar narrated to us, from Saʿīd b. Abī Burda, from al-Aswad, from ʿĀʾisha, who said:
records.matn_en: “You are neglectful of the best worship: humility.”
translator_notes: The wording is awkward in the source (‘the best worship’ and ‘humility’ are both in the accusative) and the rendering is tentative.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ دُكَيْنٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، ⦗ص: 31⦘ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ حَفْصٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ ابْنُ فُسْحُمَ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ فِي يَدِهِ تَمَرَاتٌ، فَأَلْقَى بِهَا، وَقَالَ: ‌ ‌«هَذِهِ مَعَ الدُّنْيَا، ثُمَّ تَقَدَّمَ فَقَاتَلَ حَتَّى قُتِلَ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Dukayn narrated to us. He said: Misʿar narrated to us, [p. 31] from Abū Bakr b. Ḥafṣ, who said:
records.matn_en: On the day of Badr, Ibn Fusḥum had some dates in his hand; he threw them away and said: “These belong with this world.” Then he advanced and fought until he was killed.
translator_notes: In the source the quotation marks enclose the whole sentence, including ‘Then he advanced and fought until he was killed’, which is the narrator’s statement. ‘Abū Nuʿaym’ and ‘Ibn Dukayn’ are the same person, al-Faḍl b. Dukayn.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ دُكَيْنٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ: ‌
records.matn_ar: ‌«كَانَ عِيسَى عليه السلام ⦗ص: 32⦘ يَأْكُلُ الشَّجَرَ، وَيَلْبَسُ الشَّعْرَ، وَيَبِيتُ حَيْثُ يُمْسِي، وَلَا يُخَبِّئُ لِغَدٍ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلَدٌ يَمُوتُ، وَلَا بَيْتٌ يَخْرَبُ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Dukayn narrated to us. He said: Misʿar narrated to us, from ʿAmr b. Murra, from Mujāhid, who said:
records.matn_en: Jesus (a) [p. 32] used to eat from the trees and wear hair [garments], and he would spend the night wherever evening found him, and he did not store anything for the morrow. He had no child who might die and no house that might fall into ruin.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ طَرِيفٍ، قَالَ: ⦗ص: 33⦘ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ: " أَنَّ مُوسَى، سَأَلَ رَبَّهُ، فَقَالَ: أَيْ رَبِّ،‌ ‌ مَنِ الَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ دَارَ قُدْسِكَ؟ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: يَا مُوسَى، هُمُ النَّقِيَّةُ أَيْدِيهِمْ، الطَّاهِرَةُ قُلُوبُهُمْ، الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرْتُ ذُكِرُوا، وَإِذَا ذَكَرُونِي ذَكَرْتُهُمُ، الَّذِينَ يَتَحَابُّونَ بِجَلَالِي، وَيَعْمُرُونَ مَسَاجِدِي، وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ بِالْأَسْحَارِ، الَّذِينَ يُنِيبُونَ إِلَى ذِكْرِي كَمَا تُنِيبُ النُّسُورُ إِلَى وُكُورِهَا، الَّذِينَ يَغْضَبُونَ لِمَحَارِمِي كَمَا يَغْضَبُ النَّمِرُ إِذَا حَرِبَ "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Ḥasan b. Ṭarīf narrated to us. He said: [p. 33] Ismāʿīl b. ʿAyyāsh narrated to us, from Zayd b. Aslam:
records.matn_en: That Moses asked his Lord and said: O my Lord, who are those who inherit the abode of Your holiness? He said: O Moses, they are those whose hands are clean and whose hearts are pure; those who, when I am mentioned, are mentioned, and when they mention Me, I mention them; those who love one another through My majesty, who populate My mosques, and who seek forgiveness in the hours before dawn; those who turn back to the remembrance of Me as eagles turn back to their nests; those who become angry for the sake of My prohibitions as the tiger becomes enraged when it is provoked.
translator_notes: Zayd b. Aslam gives this account without naming a source.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ: " أَنَّ سَائِلًا سَأَلَ يَعْقُوبَ فَقَالَ: عَمَّ نُحُولُ جِسْمِكَ، وَسُقُوطُ حَاجِبَيْكَ عَلَى عَيْنَيْكَ؟ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: طُولُ الزَّمَانِ، وَكَثْرَةُ الْأَحْزَانِ، فَأَوْحَى اللَّهُ تبارك وتعالى إِلَيْهِ: يَا يَعْقُوبُ،‌ ‌ أَتَشْكُونِي إِلَى عِبَادِي؟ قَالَ: أَيْ رَبِّ، خَطِيئَةٌ أَخْطَأْتُهَا، وَذَنْبٌ أَذْنَبْتُهُ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Ḥasan narrated to us. He said: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, from Sulaymān b. Sulaym:
records.matn_en: That a questioner asked Jacob: Why is your body so wasted, and why do your eyebrows droop over your eyes? He said: The length of time and the abundance of sorrows. Then God, Blessed and Exalted, revealed to him: O Jacob, do you complain of Me to My servants? He said: O my Lord, it was a fault I committed and a sin I committed; so forgive me.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَرِيفٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ ثَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ: أَنَّ الْمَسِيحَ عليه السلام قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «يَا مَعْشَرَ الْحَوَارِيِّينَ،‌ ‌ إِنْ أَحْبَبْتُمْ أَنْ تَكُونُوا مِنْ أَصْفِيَاءِ اللَّهِ، وَنُورِ بَنِي آدَمَ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ، فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَ النَّاسِ، وَأَحِبُّوا مَنْ بَغَضَكُمْ» . قَالَ: وَسَمِعْتُ بَعْضَ مَنْ يَقْرَأُ الْكُتُبَ: إِنَّهُ مَكْتُوبٌ فِي الْإِنْجِيلِ: «أَفْلَحَ الَّذِينَ يُصْلِحُونَ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ، أُولَئِكَ خَصَائِصُ اللَّهِ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Ṭarīf narrated to us, from Ismāʿīl, from Thaʿlaba b. Muslim, from Abū ʿImrān al-Anṣārī:
records.matn_en: That the Messiah (a) said: “O company of the disciples (al-ḥawāriyyūn), if you wish to be among God’s chosen ones and the light of the children of Adam among His creation, then reconcile people, and love those who hate you.” He said: And I heard some of those who read the books [say]: It is written in the Gospel: “Successful are those who reconcile people; those are God’s elect (khaṣāʾiṣ) among His creation.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَرِيفٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ⦗ص: 35⦘ إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّ يَزِيدَ بْنَ مَيْسَرَةَ قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " يُقَالُ لِصَاحِبِ السُّلْطَانِ: أَيُّهَا الْمُسَلَّطُ،‌ ‌ لَا يَنْفُخُكَ رَوْحُ السُّلْطَانِ؛ فَإِنَّكَ إِنَّمَا خُلِقْتَ مِنْ تُرَابٍ، وَإِلَى تُرَابٍ تَعُودُ، وَرِثْتَ مَكَانَ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكَ ، وَغَيْرُكَ وَارِثٌ مَكَانَكَ غَدًا "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Ṭarīf narrated to us. He said: [p. 35] Ismāʿīl b. ʿAyyāsh narrated to us, from Ṣafwān b. ʿAmr, that Yazīd b. Maysara said:
records.matn_en: It is said to the man of authority: O you who have been given power, let not the spirit of authority puff you up; for you were created only from dust, and to dust you will return. You have inherited the place of one who came before you, and another will inherit your place tomorrow.
translator_notes: The word rendered ‘spirit’ (rūḥ) may be meant as rawḥ (ease, comfort); the rendering is tentative.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَرِيفٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ الْكِنَانِيِّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: خَرَجَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ فِي جَنَازَةٍ، فَرَأَى أَهْلَ الْمَيِّتِ يَبْكُونَ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ: «مَسَاكِينُ،‌ ‌ مَوْتَى غَدًا يَبْكُونَ عَلَى مَيِّتِ الْيَوْمِ؟ »
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Ṭarīf narrated to us. He said: Ismāʿīl narrated to us, from Sulaymān b. Sulaym al-Kinānī, from Yaḥyā b. Jābir, who said:
records.matn_en: Abū al-Dardāʾ went out to a funeral and saw the family of the dead man weeping over him. He said: “Poor wretches! Will those who are the dead of tomorrow weep over the dead man of today?”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَرِيفٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا كَثِيرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ،
records.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: ‌ ‌{فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ لِلْأَوَّابِينَ ⦗ص: 36⦘ غَفُورًا} [الإسراء: 25] ، قَالَ: «التَّوَّابِينَ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Ṭarīf narrated to us. He said: Kathīr b. Sulaym narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, concerning His saying:
records.matn_en: {For He is ever Forgiving to the oft-returning (al-awwābīn) [p. 36]} [Q. 17:25]. He said: “The repentant (al-tawwābīn).”
translator_notes: The page marker [p. 36] falls inside the verse in the source, after ‘al-awwābīn’ and before ‘ghafūran’ (‘Forgiving’).

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَرِيفٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جَسْرٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُمْ سَأَلُوا أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَائِشَةَ فِي قَوْلِهِ فِي الْمَلَائِكَةِ: ‌ ‌{ثُمَّ أَوْرَثَنَا الْكِتَابَ} [فاطر: 32] ، قَالَتْ: السَّابِقُ بِالْخَيْرَاتِ: مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَالْمُقْتَصِدُ: أَصْحَابُهُ، وَالظَّالِمُ لِنَفْسِهِ: مِثْلِي وَمِثْلُكَ وَمِثْلُ هَذَا "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Ṭarīf narrated to us. He said: Jasr narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī ʿAbd al-Raḥmān:
records.matn_en: That they asked the Mother of the Believers ʿĀʾisha about His saying concerning the angels: {Then We gave the Book as an inheritance} [Q. 35:32]. She said: The one who is foremost in good deeds (al-sābiq bi-l-khayrāt) is Muḥammad ﷺ; the moderate one (al-muqtaṣid) is his Companions; and the one who wrongs himself is the like of me, and the like of you, and the like of this one.

narrators.en: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī ʿAbd al-Raḥmān

translator_notes: The phrase ‘concerning the angels’ is as printed in the source; the verse quoted does not concern angels, and the wording may be corrupt. The source has a closing quotation mark with no opening one.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَرِيفٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جَسْرٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا النُّعْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: خَرَجَ فِي جَنَازَةٍ، فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ اتَّكَأَ عِنْدَ قَبْرٍ، فَنَعَسَ أَنَسٌ، فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِ صَاحِبُ الْقَبْرِ فَقَالَ:‌ ‌ كَأَنَّكَ تَهَاوَنْتَ بِرَكْعَتَيْكَ قَبْلُ، لَئِنْ نَقْدِرُ عَلَى مِثْلِهَا أَحَبُّ إِلَيْنَا مِنْ كَذَا وَكَذَا، إِنَّكُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ وَلَا تَعْلَمُونَ، وَإِنَّا نَحْنُ نَعْلَمُ وَلَا نَقْدِرُ عَلَى الْعَمَلِ "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Ṭarīf narrated to us. He said: Jasr narrated to us. He said: al-Nuʿmān b. Abī Bakr b. Anas narrated to us, from Anas b. Mālik, who said:
records.matn_en: He went out to a funeral and prayed two light rakʿas, then reclined beside a grave, and Anas dozed off. The occupant of the grave came out to him and said: It is as though you made light of your two rakʿas just now. Our being able to do the like of them would be dearer to us than such-and-such. You act and do not know, whereas we know and are unable to act.

narrators.en: al-Nuʿmān b. Abī Bakr b. Anas

translator_notes: The subject of the first verbs (‘He went out…’) is not named; the sequel suggests it is Anas. The wording of the dead man’s speech is awkward and the rendering is tentative. The source has a closing quotation mark with no opening one.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَرِيفٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جَسْرٌ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «ابْنَ آدَمَ، طَإِ الْأَرْضَ بِقَدَمِكَ، فَإِنَّهَا عَنْ قَلِيلٍ قَبْرُكَ، فَوَاللَّهِ‌ ‌ مَا زِلْتَ فِي هَدْمِ عُمُرِكَ مُنْذُ سَقَطْتَ مِنْ بَطْنِ أُمِّكَ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Ṭarīf narrated to us. He said: Jasr narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, who said:
records.matn_en: “Son of Adam, tread the earth with your foot, for before long it will be your grave. By God, you have not ceased demolishing your lifespan since you fell from your mother’s womb.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَرِيفٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ⦗ص: 38⦘ جَسْرٌ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ الْحَسَنُ إِلَى جَانِبِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو فِي الْمَقْصُورَةِ، وَالنَّضْرُ أَمِيرُ الْبَصْرَةِ، فَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ:‌ ‌ أَدْرَكْتُ صَدْرَ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ يَنَامُونَ عَلَى أَطْرَافِهِمْ، يَفْتَرِشُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ، قَدْ جَرَتْ دُمُوعُهُمْ عَلَى خُدُودِهِمْ، يُنَاجُونَ رَبَّهُمْ فِي فَكَاكِ أَرْقَابِهِمْ، فَإِذَا عَمِلُوا سَيِّئَةً سَاءَتْهُمْ وَأَحْزَنَتْهُمْ، وَدَعَوُا اللَّهَ أَنْ يَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ، فَوَاللَّهِ مَا سَلِمَ الْقَوْمُ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَمَا نَجَوْا إِلَّا بِالْمَغْفِرَةِ، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَى النَّضْرِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو فَقَالَ لَهُ: فَأَصْبَحْتَ وَاللَّهِ مُخَالِفًا لِلْقَوْمِ فِي الْعَمَلِ وَالسِّيرَةِ، فَإِيَّاكَ أَنْ تَرْجَحَ فِي الْأَمَانِيِّ فَمَا أَبْعَدَ صِفَتَكَ مِنْ صِفَةِ الْقَوْمِ، وَإِنَّ أَخَاكَ مَنْ نَصَحَكَ، وَمَنْ نَصَحَكَ خَيْرٌ لَكَ مِمَّنْ يَغُرُّكَ وَيُمَنِّيكَ، النَّجَا النَّجَا، الْوَحَا الْوَحَا، أَنْتُمْ وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ عَلَى مَا تُعَرِّجُونَ، فَقَطِّعُوا عَنْكُمْ حِبَالَ الدُّنْيَا، وَغَلِّقُوا عَنْكُمْ أَبْوَابَهَا، كَأَنَّكُمْ رَكْبٌ وُقُوفٌ، إِذَا دُعِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَجَابَ "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Ṭarīf narrated to us. He said: [p. 38] Jasr narrated to us. He said:
records.matn_en: Al-Ḥasan was beside al-Naḍr b. ʿAmr in the enclosure (maqṣūra), and al-Naḍr was the governor of Basra. Al-Ḥasan said: I met the foremost of this community; they would sleep on their sides, spreading out their faces, their tears running down their cheeks, whispering to their Lord for the freeing of their necks. When they committed a wrong act it distressed and grieved them, and they asked God to forgive them. By God, the people were not free of sins, and they escaped only through forgiveness. Then he turned to al-Naḍr b. ʿAmr and said to him: By God, you have come to differ from those people in deed and in conduct, so beware of leaning toward wishful hopes, for how far your description is from theirs. Your true brother is the one who gives you sincere advice, and one who advises you is better for you than one who deceives you and fills you with hopes. Flee, flee! Hasten, hasten! By the Lord of the Kaʿba, you are lingering on [the way]; so cut off from yourselves the ropes of the world and bolt its doors against you, as though you were a riding party standing still: when one of you is called, he answers.
translator_notes: The rendering of several expressions is tentative (‘spreading out their faces’, ‘leaning toward wishful hopes’, ‘lingering on [the way]’). The source has a closing quotation mark with no opening one.

records.text_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْأُوَيْسِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ: ‌ ‌«كَانَ فِرَاشُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ أَدَمٍ حَشْوُهُ لِيفٌ» . ⦗ص: 39⦘ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْأُوَيْسِيُّ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، نَحْوَهُ
records.text_en: [14] Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Uwaysī narrated to us. He said: Ibn Abī al-Zinād narrated to us, from Hishām b. ʿUrwa, from his father, from ʿĀʾisha, who said: “The bedding of the Messenger of God ﷺ was of tanned leather stuffed with palm fibre.” [p. 39] [14] Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Uwaysī narrated to us. He said: Ibn Abī al-Zinād narrated to us, from Hishām, from his father, from ʿĀʾisha, the like of it.
records.no_isnad_reason: Several reports share this source record; they are shown together, as the source prints them.
translator_notes: A second chain for the same narration, given under the same number in the source.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْأُوَيْسِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ وَلَدِ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: "‌ ‌ حَضَرَ مَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ رَجُلًا يَمُوتُ، فَشَقَّ أَعْضَاءَهُ فَلَمْ يَجِدْهُ عَمِلَ خَيْرًا، ثُمَّ شَقَّ قَلْبَهُ فَلَمْ يَجِدْ فِيهِ خَيْرًا، ثُمَّ فَكَّ لَحْيَيْهِ فَوَجَدَ طَرَفَ لِسَانِهِ لَاصِقًا بِحَنَكِهِ، يَقُولُ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ. قَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ⦗ص: 40⦘ «فَغُفِرَ لَهُ بِكَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Uwaysī narrated to us. He said: Ibn Abī al-Zinād narrated to us, from Mūsā b. ʿUqba, from a man of the descendants of ʿUbāda b. al-Ṣāmit, from Abū Hurayra, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “The Angel of Death attended a man who was dying. He split open his limbs and found that he had done no good; then he split open his heart and found no good in it; then he unfastened his jaws and found the tip of his tongue stuck to his palate, saying: There is no god but God.” The Prophet ﷺ said: [p. 40] “So he was forgiven through the word of sincerity (kalimat al-ikhlāṣ).”

narrators.en: a man of the descendants of ʿUbāda b. al-Ṣāmit (unnamed)

translator_notes: The transmitter between Mūsā b. ʿUqba and Abū Hurayra is not named. The source has an opening quotation mark and no closing one.

records.isnad_ar: وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
records.matn_ar: "‌ ‌ أَمَرَ اللَّهُ عز وجل بِعَبْدٍ إِلَى النَّارِ، فَلَمَّا وَقَفَ عَلَى شَفَتِهَا الْتَفَتَ فَقَالَ: أَمَا وَاللَّهِ يَا رَبِّ إِنْ كَانَ ظَنِّي بِكَ لَحَسَنٌ، قَالَ اللَّهُ عز وجل: رُدُّوهُ، فَأَنَا عِنْدَ حُسْنِ ظَنِّ عَبْدِي بِي، فَأُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ "
records.isnad_en: And the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “God, Mighty and Majestic, commanded that a servant be taken to the Fire. When he stood at its lip he turned and said: By God, my Lord, my opinion of You was surely a good one! God, Mighty and Majestic, said: Bring him back, for I am [as] My servant thinks of Me. So he was admitted to Paradise.”
translator_notes: Printed again as number 15 in the source; it has no chain of its own and continues the preceding narration.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْأُوَيْسِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ‌
records.matn_ar: ‌«مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ مُؤْمِنٍ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ عَيْنِهِ دُمُوعٌ مِنْ خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مِثْلَ رَأْسِ الذُّبَابِ، فَتُصِيبُ شَيْئًا، إِلَّا حَرَّمَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى النَّارِ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Uwaysī narrated to us. He said: Sulaymān b. Bilāl narrated to us, from Muḥammad b. Abī Ḥumayd, from ʿAwn b. ʿAbd Allāh, from his father, from ʿAbd Allāh b. Masʿūd, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “There is no believing servant from whose eye tears come out from fear of God—even if as small as the head of a fly—and they strike something, but God forbids him to the Fire.”
translator_notes: The object of ‘strike’ is not stated in the source; it is rendered literally.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُمَرَ الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ: " ‌
records.matn_ar: ‌{أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَانِتٌ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ} [الزمر: 9] ، قَالَ: سَاعَاتِ اللَّيْلِ، أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ وَأَوْسَطَهُ "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Abū ʿUmar al-Ḥawḍī narrated to us. He said: al-Mubārak b. Faḍāla narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan:
records.matn_en: {Is he who is devoutly obedient (qānit) during the hours of the night} [Q. 39:9]. He said: “The hours of the night: its beginning, its end and its middle.”
translator_notes: Under number 17 the source gives a series of al-Ḥasan’s comments on Qurʾānic verses, each printed as a separate paragraph; they are given here as separate entries under the same number.

records.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ: ‌ ‌
records.matn_ar: {وَتَأْكُلُونَ التُّرَاثَ} [الفجر: 19] ، قَالَ: «التُّرَاثُ نَصِيبُهُ وَنَصِيبُ صَاحِبِهِ، حَلَالُهُ وَحَرَامُهُ»
records.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
records.matn_en: {And you devour the inheritance (al-turāth)} [Q. 89:19]. He said: “The inheritance: his share and the share of his companion, its lawful and its unlawful.”

records.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ: ‌ ‌
records.matn_ar: {فَلَوْلَا أَنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُسَبِّحِينَ} [الصافات: 143] ، قَالَ: «لَوْلَا أَنَّهُ قَدَّمَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطْنِهِ»
records.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
records.matn_en: {Had he not been one of those who glorify [God]} [Q. 37:143]. He said: “Had he not put forward a righteous deed, he would have remained in its belly.”

records.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ: ‌ ‌
records.matn_ar: {كَذَلِكَ نَبْلُوهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوا يَفْسُقُونَ} [الأعراف: 163] ، قَالَ: «بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ مِنَ الْمَعَاصِي»
records.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
records.matn_en: {Thus We test them for their disobedience (yafsuqūn)} [Q. 7:163]. He said: “For the acts of disobedience they used to commit before that.”

records.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ: ‌ ‌
records.matn_ar: {اللُّؤْلُؤُ وَالْمَرْجَانُ} [الرحمن: 22] ، قَالَ: " اللُّؤْلُؤُ: الْعِظَامُ، وَالْمَرْجَانُ: الصِّغَارُ "
records.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
records.matn_en: {Pearl and coral (al-luʾluʾ wa-l-marjān)} [Q. 55:22]. He said: “The pearl: the large ones; and the coral: the small ones.”

records.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ: ‌ ‌
records.matn_ar: {وَإِذَا أَرَدْنَا أَنْ نُهْلِكَ قَرْيَةً أَمَرْنَا مُتْرَفِيهَا} [الإسراء: 16] ، قَالَ: " كَانَ أَهْلُ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ إِذَا كَثُرَ الْقَوْمُ قَالُوا: أَمَرَ بَنُو فُلَانٍ "
records.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
records.matn_en: {And when We intend to destroy a town, We command its affluent (amarnā mutrafīhā)} [Q. 17:16]. He said: “In the Jāhiliyya, when a people became numerous, they would say: Banū so-and-so have become numerous (amira).”
translator_notes: Al-Ḥasan understands the verb as ‘We made numerous’ (from amira/āmara, ‘to increase’), not as ‘We commanded’.

records.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ: ‌ ‌
records.matn_ar: {وَإِنَّا لَجَاعِلُونَ مَا عَلَيْهَا صَعِيدًا جُرُزًا} [الكهف: 8] ، قَالَ: لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ "
records.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
records.matn_en: {And We will surely make what is on it barren dust (ṣaʿīdan juruzan)} [Q. 18:8]. He said: Nothing is on it.

records.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ: ‌ ‌
records.matn_ar: {تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَصُوحًا} [التحريم: 8] ، قَالَ: «يَتْرُكُ الذَّنْبَ ثُمَّ لَا يَعُودُ إِلَيْهِ»
records.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
records.matn_en: {Repent to God with sincere repentance (tawbatan naṣūḥan)} [Q. 66:8]. He said: “That he leaves the sin and then does not return to it.”

records.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ: ‌ ‌
records.matn_ar: {وَكُلَّ إِنْسَانٍ أَلْزَمْنَاهُ طَائِرَهُ فِي عُنُقِهِ} [الإسراء: 13] ، قَالَ: «عَمَلُهُ»
records.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
records.matn_en: {And every human being, We have fastened his fate (ṭāʾirahu) to his neck} [Q. 17:13]. He said: “His deed.”

records.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ: ‌ ‌
records.matn_ar: {لَأَوَّاهٌ} [التوبة: 114] قَالَ: «الرَّحِيمُ بِعِبَادِ اللَّهِ»
records.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
records.matn_en: {Surely tender-hearted (la-awwāh)} [Q. 9:114]. He said: “The one who is merciful to God’s servants.”

records.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ: ‌ ‌
records.matn_ar: {قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ} [الحاقة: 23] ، قَالَ: «تَدْنُو مِنْهُ حَتَّى يَتَنَاوَلَهَا مِنْ حَيْثُ شَاءَ»
records.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
records.matn_en: {Its fruits are within reach (quṭūfuhā dāniya)} [Q. 69:23]. He said: “They come near to him until he takes them from wherever he wishes.”

records.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ: ‌ ‌
records.matn_ar: {وَمِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ بَرْزَخٌ إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ} [المؤمنون: 100] ، قَالَ: «الْقُبُورُ»
records.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
records.matn_en: {And behind them is a barrier (barzakh) until the day they are resurrected} [Q. 23:100]. He said: “The graves.”

records.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ: ‌ ‌
records.matn_ar: {فَهَلْ يَنْتَظِرُونَ إِلَّا مِثْلَ أَيَّامِ الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ} [يونس: 102] ، قَالَ: " خُوِّفُوا بِالْعَذَابِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: {بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَالسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَى وَأَمَرُّ} [القمر: 46] "
records.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
records.matn_en: {Then do they wait for anything but the like of the days of those who passed away before them?} [Q. 10:102]. He said: “They were threatened with punishment.” Then he said: {Rather, the Hour is their appointed time, and the Hour is more calamitous and more bitter} [Q. 54:46].

records.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ: ‌ ‌
records.matn_ar: {ذَرَأْنَا لِجَهَنَّمَ} [الأعراف: 179] ، قَالَ: «خَلَقْنَا لِجَهَنَّمَ»
records.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
records.matn_en: {We have created for Jahannam (dharaʾnā li-Jahannam)} [Q. 7:179]. He said: “We created for Jahannam.”

records.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ: ‌ ‌
records.matn_ar: {فَلَمَّا آسَفُونَا} [الزخرف: 55] ، قَالَ: «أَغْضَبُونَا»
records.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
records.matn_en: {So when they vexed Us (āsafūnā)} [Q. 43:55]. He said: “They angered Us.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُمَرَ الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: ⦗ص: 43⦘ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التُّسْتَرِيُّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «إِلَا إِنَّ‌ ‌ مَطْعَمَ ابْنِ آدَمَ ضُرِبَ مَثَلًا لِلدُّنْيَا، أَلَا وَإِنْ قَزَّحَهُ وَمَلَّحَهُ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Abū ʿUmar al-Ḥawḍī narrated to us. He said: [p. 43] Yazīd b. Ibrāhīm al-Tustarī narrated to us. He said: I heard al-Ḥasan relating from Ubayy b. Kaʿb, who said:
records.matn_en: “Beware: the food of the son of Adam has been made a parable for the world—even if he seasons it with spices and salts it.”
translator_notes: The saying seems abbreviated: the parable concerns what the food becomes, which the source does not state; the rendering is tentative.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: لَمَّا حَضَرَ سَلْمَانَ الْمَوْتُ بَكَى، فَقِيلَ لَهُ: مَا يُبْكِيكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: " أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لَا أَبْكِي جَزَعًا عَلَى الْمَوْتِ وَلَا حِرْصًا، وَلَكِنْ إِنَّمَا أَبْكِي لِأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَهِدَ إِلَيْنَا فَقَالَ: ‌ ‌«يَكْفِي أَحَدَكُمْ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا كَزَادِ الرَّاكِبِ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Ḥawḍī narrated to us. He said: Yazīd narrated to us. He said: I heard al-Ḥasan say: When death came to Salmān he wept. He was asked: What makes you weep, Abū ʿAbd Allāh? He said:
records.matn_en: “By God, I do not weep out of dread of death or out of eagerness [for the world], but I weep only because the Messenger of God ﷺ made a covenant with us and said: ‘It suffices one of you of the world to have the like of a rider’s provision.’”
translator_notes: ‘Salmān’ is presumably Salmān al-Fārisī, though the source does not specify. The source has an opening quotation mark and no closing one.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ⦗ص: 47⦘ يَزِيدُ، قَالَ: وَسَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ، يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: قَالَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ: «ابْنَ آدَمَ،‌ ‌ اعْمَلْ كَأَنَّكَ تَرَاهُ، وَاعْدُدْ نَفْسَكَ فِي الْمَوْتَى، وَاتَّقِ دَعْوَةَ الْمَظْلُومِ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Ḥawḍī narrated to us. He said: [p. 47] Yazīd narrated to us. He said: And I heard al-Ḥasan say: Abū al-Dardāʾ said:
records.matn_en: “Son of Adam, act as though you see Him, count yourself among the dead, and beware the supplication of the wronged.”

records.isnad_ar: قَالَ الْحَسَنُ: وَقَالَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ: ‌ ‌
records.matn_ar: «مَنْ لَمْ يَعْرِفْ نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا فِي مَطْعَمِهِ وَمَشْرَبِهِ، فَقَدْ قَلَّ عَمَلُهُ، وَحَضَرَ عَذَابُهُ»
records.isnad_en: Al-Ḥasan said: And Abū al-Dardāʾ said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever knows God’s favour upon him only in his food and drink has few deeds, and his punishment is present.”
translator_notes: A continuation of number 20; it has no chain of its own beyond ‘al-Ḥasan said’.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ ⦗ص: 48⦘ طَهْمَانَ، قَالَ أَبُو حَاتِمٍ: هُوَ الْمُعْتَمِرُ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ، يَقُولُ: ‌ ‌
records.matn_ar: «خِيَارُكُمْ يَذْهَبُونَ، وَأَنْتُمْ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ تَرْذُلُونَ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Ḥawḍī narrated to us. He said: Yazīd b. [p. 48] Ṭahmān narrated to us—Abū Ḥātim said: He is al-Muʿtamir—he said: I heard al-Ḥasan say:
records.matn_en: “The best of you are going away, while you become baser every day.”
translator_notes: The aside ‘He is al-Muʿtamir’ is Abū Ḥātim’s own identification of Yazīd b. Ṭahmān.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ،
records.matn_ar: قَالَ أَبُو حَاتِمٍ: شَيْخٌ قَدِيمٌ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ نَسِيٍّ، أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ: " أَنَّ‌ ‌ مُوسَى عليه السلام حَجَّ عَلَى نَاقَةٍ حَمْرَاءَ، وَأَنَّ عِيسَى عليه السلام حَجَّ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ، أَوْ عَلَى ثَوْرٍ
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Ḥawḍī narrated to us. He said: al-Ḍaḥḥāk b. Yasār narrated to us—Abū Ḥātim said: an old shaykh—from ʿUbāda b. Nusayy, that it had reached him:
records.matn_en: That Moses (a) performed the pilgrimage on a red she-camel, and that Jesus (a) performed the pilgrimage on his riding beast, or on a bull.
translator_notes: ‘It had reached him’ indicates a report without a full chain. The source has an opening quotation mark and no closing one.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُمَرَ الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُنْذِرُ بْنُ ثَعْلَبَةَ، عَنْ حَوْشَبٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ: ‌
records.matn_ar: ‌«إِنَّ الْقَلْبَ لَأَشَدُّ طَيْرُورَةً مِنَ الرِّيشَةِ فِي يَوْمٍ عَاصِفٍ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Abū ʿUmar al-Ḥawḍī narrated to us. He said: al-Mundhir b. Thaʿlaba narrated to us, from Ḥawshab, from al-Ḥasan, who said:
records.matn_en: “The heart is more apt to flutter than a feather on a stormy day.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: ‌
records.matn_ar: ‌{حُورٌ مَقْصُورَاتٌ فِي الْخِيَامِ} [الرحمن: 72] ، قَالَ: «دُرٌّ مُجَوَّفٌ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Ḥawḍī narrated to us. He said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Malik b. Maysara, from Abū al-Aḥwaṣ, from ʿAbd Allāh:
records.matn_en: {Houris (ḥūr) secluded in pavilions} [Q. 55:72]. He said: “A hollow pearl.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ: ‌
records.matn_ar: ‌«كَمْ مِنْ يَدٍ ⦗ص: 49⦘ فَاجِرَةٍ قَدْ هَمَّتْ، فَمَنَعَهَا اللَّهُ وَكَفَّهَا» حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: هَذَا مِنْ غُرَرِ الْحَدِيثِ
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Ḥawḍī narrated to us. He said: Ḥammād b. Zayd narrated to us, from Hishām b. Ḥassān, from al-Ḥasan, who said:
records.matn_en: “How many a wicked hand [p. 49] has intended [harm], and God has prevented it and held it back!” Abū Ḥātim narrated to us; he said: This is among the choicest sayings (ghurar) of ḥadīth.
translator_notes: The closing comment is Abū Ḥātim’s own, though the source introduces it with the transmission formula ‘narrated to us’.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُمَرَ الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُبَارَكُ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ: ‌
records.matn_ar: ‌{أَنْكَالًا} [المزمل: 12] قَالَ: «الْقُيُودُ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Abū ʿUmar al-Ḥawḍī narrated to us. He said: al-Mubārak narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan, who said:
records.matn_en: {Fetters (ankāl)} [Q. 73:12]. He said: “Shackles (al-quyūd).”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سَلَّامُ بْنُ مِسْكِينٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قَرَأَ الْحَسَنُ هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ: ‌ ‌{لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا} [الإسراء: 62] ، قَالَ: «حِينَ رَامَ آدَمُ فَصَرَعَهُ تِلْكَ الصَّرْعَةَ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Ḥawḍī narrated to us. He said: Sallām b. Miskīn narrated to us. He said: Al-Ḥasan recited this verse:
records.matn_en: {I will surely seize his descendants (la-aḥtanikanna), except a few} [Q. 17:62]. He said: “When Adam sought [it], and he threw him down with that throw.”
translator_notes: The comment is terse and its subjects are not marked; ‘he threw him down’ presumably refers to Iblīs’s overthrow of Adam. The rendering is tentative.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، عَنِ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ: ‌
records.matn_ar: ‌{مُتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ} [الكهف: 31] قَالَ: «الْأَسِرَّةُ فِي الْحِجَالِ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Ḥawḍī narrated to us, from al-Mubārak, from al-Ḥasan:
records.matn_en: {Reclining therein on couches (arāʾik)} [Q. 18:31]. He said: “Beds within canopies (ḥijāl).”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، عَنِ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانُوا يَقُولُونَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّا لَنُحِبُّ اللَّهَ، فَأَرَادَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ لِحُبِّهِمْ إِيَّاهُ عِلْمًا، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عز وجل: ‌ ‌{إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ اللَّهَ فَاتَّبَعُونِي} [آل عمران: 31] الْآيَةَ
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Ḥawḍī narrated to us, from al-Mubārak, from al-Ḥasan, who said:
records.matn_en: They used to say: O Messenger of God, we do love God. So God wished to make a sign (ʿilm) for their love of Him, and God, Mighty and Majestic, sent down: {If you love God, then follow me} [Q. 3:31]—the verse [continues].

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَوْفٍ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: "‌ ‌ مِنْ خِصَالِ الْمُنَافِقِ: يُحِبُّ الْمَدْحَ، وَيَكْرَهُ الذَّمَّ "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Ḥawḍī narrated to us. He said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from ʿAwf, from a man, from Wahb b. Munabbih, who said:
records.matn_en: “Among the traits of the hypocrite: he loves praise and dislikes blame.”
translator_notes: An unnamed man stands between ʿAwf and Wahb b. Munabbih.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ شَرْقِيٍّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عِكْرِمَةَ: ‌
records.matn_ar: ‌{يَعْلَمُونَ ظَاهِرًا مِنَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا} [الروم: 7] ، قَالَ: «الْأَعْمَالُ» وَذَكَرَ السِّرَاجَ وَنَحْوَهُ
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Ḥawḍī narrated to us. He said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from Sharqī, who said: I heard ʿIkrima [say]:
records.matn_en: {They know what is apparent of the life of this world} [Q. 30:7]. He said: “Deeds.” And he mentioned the lamp and the like.
translator_notes: The point of ‘the lamp and the like’ is not clear; presumably worldly crafts are meant as examples. The rendering is tentative.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الْأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، ⦗ص: 51⦘ عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: ‌
records.matn_ar: ‌«مَا كَانَ مِنْ نَظْرَةٍ فَإِنَّ لِلشَّيْطَانِ فِيهَا مَطْمَعًا»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Ḥawḍī narrated to us. He said: Abū ʿAwāna narrated to us, from Sulaymān al-Aʿmash, from Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Yazīd, [p. 51] from Abū al-Aḥwaṣ, from ʿAbd Allāh, who said:
records.matn_en: “No glance occurs but that Satan has a place of hope in it.”

narrators.en: Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Yazīd

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا صَالِحٌ أَبُو خُزَيْمَةَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ، يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: " ‌ ‌{ذَلِكَ مَا كُنْتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ} [ق: 19] ، قَالَ: «فَاسِقٌ فِي الْحَيَاةِ، مُفْسِدٌ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Ḥawḍī narrated to us. He said: Ṣāliḥ Abū Khuzayma narrated to us. He said: I heard al-Ḥasan say:
records.matn_en: {That is what you were trying to avoid (taḥīd)} [Q. 50:19]. He said: “A sinner in life, a corrupter at death.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ كُرْدُوسِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو،
records.matn_ar: قَالَ أَبُو حَاتِمٍ: كُرْدُوسٌ هُوَ أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، وَكَانَ يَقْرَأُ الْكُتُبَ، قَالَ: يَجِدُهُ فِيمَا يَقْرَأُ مِنَ الْكُتُبِ: ‌ ‌«إِنَّ اللَّهَ تبارك وتعالى لَيَبْتَلِي الْعَبْدَ وَهُوَ يُحِبُّهُ؛ لِيَسْمَعَ تَضَرُّعَهُ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Ḥawḍī narrated to us. He said: Shuʿba narrated to us, from ʿAmr b. Murra, from Abū Wāʾil, from Kurdūs b. ʿAmr—Abū Ḥātim said: Kurdūs is Abū Nuʿaym, and he used to read the books—he said: He finds it in what he reads of the books:
records.matn_en: “God, Blessed and Exalted, tests the servant while He loves him, in order to hear his entreaty (taḍarruʿ).”
translator_notes: The subject of ‘he finds it’ is Kurdūs. The identification of Kurdūs with ‘Abū Nuʿaym’ is Abū Ḥātim’s, as given in the source.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: نُبِّئْتُ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ كَانَ إِذَا حَضَرَ الصَّلَاةَ قَالَ: ‌ ‌«تَوَضَّئُوا؛ فَإِنَّ بَعْضَ مَا تَقُولُونَ أَشَدُّ مِنَ الْحَدَثِ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Ḥawḍī narrated to us. He said: Yazīd b. Ibrāhīm narrated to us. He said: Ibn Sīrīn narrated to us. He said: I was informed:
records.matn_en: That a man of the Anṣār used to say, when the time of prayer came: “Perform ablution; for some of what you say is worse than [ritual] impurity (ḥadath).”
translator_notes: Ibn Sīrīn reports this without naming who informed him.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ⦗ص: 52⦘ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،
records.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: ‌ ‌{فَنَادَوْا وَلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ} [ص: 3] ، قَالَ: «حِينَ لَا نَزْوَ، وَلَا فِرَارَ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Ḥawḍī narrated to us. He said: Shuʿba narrated to us, [p. 52] from Abū Isḥāq, from a man of Banū Tamīm, from Ibn ʿAbbās, concerning His saying:
records.matn_en: {So they called out, though it was no time for escape (wa-lāta ḥīna manāṣ)} [Q. 38:3]. He said: “When there is no leaping and no fleeing.”

records.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ: ‌ ‌
records.matn_ar: {وَأَنَّى لَهُمُ التَّنَاوُشُ} [سبأ: 52] ، قَالَ: «الرَّدُّ»
records.isnad_en: And concerning His saying:
records.matn_en: {And how can they have the attaining (al-tanāwush)} [Q. 34:52]. He said: “The return (al-radd).”
translator_notes: A continuation of number 36; the speaker is presumably Ibn ʿAbbās, as in the preceding record. The sense of ‘the return’ is not explained in the source.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ، يَعْنِي الرَّبَّ تبارك وتعالى: ‌ ‌«يَخْرُجُ مِنَ النَّارِ مَنْ ذَكَرَنِي يَوْمًا، أَوْ خَافَنِي فِي مَقَامٍ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Ḥawḍī narrated to us. He said: al-Mubārak b. Faḍāla narrated to us, from ʿUbayd Allāh b. Abī Bakr, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, that he said—meaning the Lord, Blessed and Exalted:
records.matn_en: “Whoever has remembered Me for a day, or feared Me in a [standing] place, will come out of the Fire.”
translator_notes: The words are God’s, reported by the Prophet ﷺ (a ḥadīth qudsī).

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ بَكْرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُزَنِيَّ
records.matn_ar: يُحَدِّثُ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً مِنْ أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ كَانَتْ تَقُولُ إِذَا أَصْبَحَتْ: " يَا نَفْسُ،‌ ‌ الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُكَ، لَا يَوْمَ لَكِ غَيْرَهُ، فَتَعْمَلُ فِي ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ تَعْمَلَ، فَإِذَا أَمْسَتْ ⦗ص: 53⦘ قَالَتْ: يَا نَفْسُ، اللَّيْلَةُ لَيْلَتُكِ، لَا لَيْلَةَ لَكِ غَيْرَهَا، فَتَعْمَلُ فِي تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ تَعْمَلَ حَتَّى تُصْبِحَ. فَلَمْ يَزَلْ ذَلِكَ دَأْبُهَا حَتَّى مَضَتْ "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Ḥawḍī narrated to us. He said: Yazīd b. Ibrāhīm narrated to us. He said: I heard Bakr b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Muzanī relate:
records.matn_en: That a woman of the people of Yemen used to say, when morning came: “O soul, today is your day; you have no day other than it; so do in this day what God wills you to do.” And when evening came, [p. 53] she would say: “O soul, tonight is your night; you have no night other than it; so do in this night what God wills you to do until morning.” This remained her practice until she passed away.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ خَتَنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ زَائِدَةَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قَالَ سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ: ‌ ‌«جَنِّبْ قَلْبَكَ الرِّيَبَ وَمَا تَخْشَى فَسَادَهُ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm b. Khālid narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz, the son-in-law of ʿUthmān b. Zāʾida, who said: Sufyān al-Thawrī said:
records.matn_en: “Keep your heart away from doubts and from what you fear will corrupt it.”

narrators.en: ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz, son-in-law of ʿUthmān b. Zāʾida

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي حَيْوَةُ بْنُ شُرَيْحٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ‌ ‌ أَبْوَابَ السَّمَاءِ تُفْتَحُ لِلرَّجُلِ لَيْلَةَ الْمِلَاكِ، يُقَالُ لَهُ: أَرَادَ التَّعَفُّفَ عَمَّا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Ḥaywa b. Shurayḥ narrated to me. He said: Ismāʿīl b. ʿAyyāsh narrated to us, from Yaḥyā b. Saʿīd al-Anṣārī, who said:
records.matn_en: “It has reached me that the doors of heaven are opened for a man on the night of the wedding (laylat al-milāk); it is said of him: He desired to abstain from what God has forbidden.”
translator_notes: ‘It has reached me’ marks a report without a chain.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ ابْنِ بَهْدَلَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ،
records.matn_ar: فِي هَذِهِ الْآيَةِ: ‌ ‌{لَابِثِينَ فِيهَا أَحْقَابًا} [النبأ: 23] ، قَالَ: «الْحُقْبُ ثَمَانُونَ عَامًا»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Hudba b. Khālid narrated to us. He said: Ḥammād b. Salama narrated to us, from ʿĀṣim b. Bahdala, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Abū Hurayra, concerning this verse:
records.matn_en: {Abiding therein for ages (aḥqāb)} [Q. 78:23]. He said: “The ḥuqb is eighty years.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ ⦗ص: 54⦘ عَمَّارِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: "‌ ‌ الْمَشْهُودُ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَالْمَوْعُودُ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَقَرَأَ: {ذَلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَجْمُوعٌ لَهُ النَّاسُ، وَذَلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَشْهُودٌ} [هود: 103] "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Ḥammād narrated to us, from [p. 54] ʿAmmār b. Abī ʿAmmār, from Ibn ʿAbbās, who said:
records.matn_en: “‘The witnessed’ is the Day of Resurrection, and ‘the promised’ is the Day of Resurrection.” And he recited: {That is a Day for which mankind will be gathered, and that is a Day witnessed} [Q. 11:103].
translator_notes: The terms ‘the witnessed’ and ‘the promised’ come from Q. 85:2–3; the source cites only Q. 11:103.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ: ‌
records.matn_ar: ‌{فَلَا تَسْمَعُ إِلَّا هَمْسًا} [طه: 108] ، قَالَ: هَمْسَ أَقْدَامِهِمْ
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Ḥammād narrated to us, from Ḥumayd, from al-Ḥasan:
records.matn_en: {And you will hear nothing but a faint sound (hams)} [Q. 20:108]. He said: The faint sound of their footsteps.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى،
records.matn_ar: فِي هَذِهِ الْآيَةِ: ‌ ‌{قَالُوا يَا وَيْلَنَا مَنْ بَعَثَنَا مِنْ مَرْقَدِنَا} [يس: 52] الْآيَةَ: يَقُولُ الْكَافِرُ: {يَا وَيْلَنَا مَنْ بَعَثَنَا مِنْ مَرْقَدِنَا} [يس: 52] ، وَيَقُولُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ: {هَذَا مَا وَعَدَ الرَّحْمَنُ وَصَدَقَ الْمُرْسَلُونَ} [يس: 52]
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Ḥammād narrated to us, from Thābit, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. Abī Laylā, concerning this verse:
records.matn_en: {They will say: Woe to us! Who has raised us from our resting place?} [Q. 36:52]—the verse [continues]: The unbeliever says: {Woe to us! Who has raised us from our resting place?} [Q. 36:52], and the believers say: {This is what the Most Merciful promised, and the messengers spoke the truth} [Q. 36:52].

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ: ‌
records.matn_ar: ‌{وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ} [ق: 16] ، قَالَ: «نِيَاطُ الْقَلْبِ وَمَا حَمَلَ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Ḥammād narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ, from Saʿīd b. Jubayr, from Ibn ʿAbbās:
records.matn_en: {And We are nearer to him than the jugular vein (ḥabl al-warīd)} [Q. 50:16]. He said: “The cord (niyāṭ) of the heart and what it carries.”
translator_notes: The sense of ‘and what it carries’ is not explained in the source.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ ⦗ص: 55⦘ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ أَبِي عِيَاضٍ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‌ ‌ كَانَ إِذَا قَرَأَ: {فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جِئْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ بِشَهِيدٍ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ عَلَى هَؤُلَاءِ شَهِيدًا} [النساء: 41] بَكَى
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Ḥammād narrated to us, from [p. 55] ʿAṭāʾ b. al-Sāʾib, from Abū ʿIyāḍ:
records.matn_en: That the Messenger of God ﷺ used to weep whenever he recited: {How then will it be when We bring from every nation a witness, and bring you as a witness over these?} [Q. 4:41]
translator_notes: Abū ʿIyāḍ reports this without naming a Companion.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ‌ ‌ الْمَلَائِكَةَ تَفْرَحُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ بِالشِّتَاءِ: أَنَّ لَيْلَهُ طَوِيلٌ يَقُومُهُ، وَأَنَّ نَهَارَهُ قَصِيرٌ يَصُومُهُ "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Hammām narrated to us, from Qatāda, from al-Ḥasan, who said:
records.matn_en: “It has reached us that the angels rejoice for the believer in winter: that its night is long and he stands in prayer through it, and that its day is short and he fasts through it.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَزْمٌ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ مَالِكَ بْنَ دِينَارٍ، يَقُولُ: ‌
records.matn_ar: ‌«لَأَنَا لِلْقَارِئِ الْفَاجِرِ أَخْوَفُ مِنِّي مِنَ الْفَاجِرِ الْمُبْرِزِ بِفُجُورِهِ، إِنَّ هَذَا أَبْعَدُهُمَا غَوْرًا»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Ḥazm narrated to us. He said: I heard Mālik b. Dīnār say:
records.matn_en: “I fear more for the sinful reciter (qāriʾ) than I fear for the sinner who flaunts his sinning; for this one is the deeper of the two in his depths.”
translator_notes: The last clause (‘the farther of the two in depth’) is obscure; the rendering is tentative.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سَلَّامٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي مُطِيعٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَيُّوبَ السِّخْتِيَانِيَّ، يَقُولُ: ‌
records.matn_ar: ‌«لَا خَبِيثَ أَخْبَثُ مِنْ قَارِئٍ فَاجِرٍ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Sallām, meaning Ibn Abī Muṭīʿ, narrated to us. He said: I heard Ayyūb al-Sakhtiyānī say:
records.matn_en: “There is no wicked one more wicked than a sinful reciter.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَزْمٌ، قَالَ: دَخَلْنَا عَلَى مَالِكِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ فِي مَرَضِهِ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ وَهُوَ يَكِيدُ بِنَفْسِهِ، فَرَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: ‌ ‌
records.matn_ar: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي ⦗ص: 57⦘ لَمْ أُحِبَّ الْبَقَاءَ فِي الدُّنْيَا لِبَطْنٍ وَلَا لِفَرْجٍ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Ḥazm narrated to us. He said: We went in to see Mālik b. Dīnār during the illness in which he died, while he was in the throes of death (yakīdu bi-nafsihi); he raised his head to heaven, then said:
records.matn_en: “O God, You know that I [p. 57] did not love remaining in the world for the sake of a belly or a private part.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَزْمٌ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ مَالِكَ بْنَ دِينَارٍ، يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: " فِي زَمَانٍ أَشْهَبَ لَا يُبْصِرُ، وَمَا بِكُمْ إِلَّا الْبَصِيرُ،‌ ‌ إِنَّكُمْ فِي زَمَانٍ كَثِيرٌ تَفَاخُرُهُمْ، أَوْ قَالَ: تَعَاجُبُهُمْ، قَدِ انْتَفَخَتْ أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ فِي أَفْوَاهِهِمْ، وَطَلَبُوا الدُّنْيَا بِعَمَلِ الْآخِرَةِ، فَاحْذَرُوهُمْ عَلَى أَنْفُسِكُمْ، لَا يُوقِعُوكُمْ فِي شَبَكَاتِهِمْ، يَا عَالِمُ، أَنْتَ عَالِمٌ تَفْخَرُ بِعِلْمِكَ ، يَا عَالِمٌ أَنْتَ عَالِمٌ تَأْكُلُ بِعِلْمِكَ ، يَا عَالِمٌ أَنْتَ عَالِمٌ تَسْتَطِيلُ بِعِلْمِكَ ، يَا عَالِمٌ أَنْتَ عَالِمٌ تُكَاثِرُ بِعِلْمِكَ، لَوْ كَانَ هَذَا الْعِلْمُ طَلَبْتَهُ لِلَّهِ لَرُئِيَ ذَلِكَ فِيكَ وَفِي عَمَلِكَ "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Ḥazm narrated to us. He said: I heard Mālik b. Dīnār say:
records.matn_en: “In a murky (ashhab) time that does not see—and none of you is anything but sighted—you are in a time whose people boast greatly—or he said: admire themselves greatly; their tongues are swollen in their mouths, and they seek the world through the deeds of the hereafter. So beware of them for yourselves, lest they entangle you in their nets. O scholar, you are a scholar who boasts of his knowledge; O scholar, you are a scholar who eats by his knowledge; O scholar, you are a scholar who lords it over others with his knowledge; O scholar, you are a scholar who vies for increase through his knowledge. If you had sought this knowledge for God’s sake, that would be seen in you and in your deeds.”
translator_notes: The opening sentence (‘a murky time that does not see…’) is obscure and the rendering is tentative.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَقِيلٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَتَّابٍ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ حَبَّانَ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ بِشْرِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " قَالَ لُقْمَانُ لِابْنِهِ: يَا بُنَيَّ،‌ ‌ اتَّخِذْ أَلْفَ صَدِيقٍ؛ فَإِنَّهُ قَلِيلٌ، وَلَا تَتَّخِذَنَّ عَدُوًّا؛ فَإِنَّهُ كَثِيرٌ "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Abū ʿAqīl narrated to us. He said: Abū ʿAttāb Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm narrated to us, from Ḥabbān b. ʿAlī, from Bishr b. Rāfiʿ, who said:
records.matn_en: “Luqmān said to his son: My son, take a thousand friends, for that is still few; and do not take [even one] enemy, for that is many.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ صَخْرٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: دَخَلْنَا عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السُّلَمِيِّ نَعُودُهُ، قَالَ: فَذَهَبْنَا نُرَجِّيهِ، فَقَالَ: ‌ ‌«أَنَا لَا أَرْجُوهُ وَقَدْ صُمْتُ ثَمَانِينَ رَمَضَانًا ؟»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Aḥmad b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Ṣakhr narrated to us. He said: Ḥammād b. Zayd narrated to us, from ʿAṭāʾ b. al-Sāʾib, who said:
records.matn_en: We went in to see Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Sulamī, visiting him in his illness. He said: We set about giving him hope, and he said: “I do not hope for Him—and I have fasted eighty Ramadans?”

narrators.en: Aḥmad b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Ṣakhr

translator_notes: The sense is uncertain: the question mark in the source suggests either ‘Do I not hope for Him…?’ or ‘Shall I hope [on the strength of my deeds]…?’. The rendering is literal and tentative.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ صَخْرٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمُ بْنُ أَخْضَرَ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُدَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ، قَالَ: ‌
records.matn_ar: ‌«لَا يَزَالُ الْعَبْدُ فِي تَوْبَةٍ مَا لَمْ يُعَايِنِ الْمَلَكَ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Ṣakhr narrated to us. He said: Sulaym b. Akhḍar informed us, from ʿImrān b. Ḥudayr, from Abū Mijlaz, who said:
records.matn_en: “The servant remains in [a state of] repentance as long as he has not beheld the angel.”

narrators.en: Aḥmad b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Ṣakhr

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ صَخْرٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا ⦗ص: 59⦘ مِسْكِينٌ أَبُو فَاطِمَةَ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا حَوْشَبٌ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ: ‌
records.matn_ar: ‌{ثُمَّ يَتُوبُونَ مِنْ قَرِيبٍ} [النساء: 17] ، قَالَ: «مَا لَمْ يُغَرْغِرْ بِالْحَيَاةِ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Ṣakhr narrated to us. He said: [p. 59] Miskīn Abū Fāṭima informed us. He said: Ḥawshab informed us, from al-Ḥasan, who said:
records.matn_en: {Then they repent soon after (min qarīb)} [Q. 4:17]. He said: “As long as he is not yet gurgling in his life (mā lam yughargir).”

narrators.en: Aḥmad b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Ṣakhr

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ صَخْرٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ: ‌
records.matn_ar: ‌{نَنْقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَا} [الرعد: 41] ، قَالَ: «الْمَوْتُ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Ṣakhr narrated to us, from Yazīd b. Zurayʿ, from Abū Rajāʾ, from al-Ḥasan:
records.matn_en: {We diminish it from its edges (aṭrāfihā)} [Q. 13:41]. He said: “Death.”

narrators.en: Aḥmad b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Ṣakhr

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ صَخْرٍ، عَنْ مُعْتَمِرٍ، عَنْ شَبِيبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ مُقَاتِلَ بْنَ حَيَّانَ،
records.matn_ar: يَقُولُ فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تبارك وتعالى: ‌ ‌{سِيمَاهُمْ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ مِنْ أَثَرِ السُّجُودِ} [الفتح: 29] ، قَالَ: " بَيَاضٌ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Ṣakhr narrated to us, from Muʿtamir, from Shabīb b. ʿAbd al-Malik, who said: I heard Muqātil b. Ḥayyān say, concerning the saying of God, Blessed and Exalted:
records.matn_en: {Their mark is on their faces from the trace of prostration} [Q. 48:29]. He said: “A whiteness on their faces on the Day of Resurrection.”

narrators.en: Aḥmad b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Ṣakhr

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمْرَضُ وَيَصِحُّ، فَلَمَّا مَرِضَ ⦗ص: 60⦘ مَرَضَهُ الَّذِي تُوُفِّيَ فِيهِ قَالَ: ‌ ‌«مَا أَرَى هَذَا إِلَّا الَّذِي لَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِتَارِكٍ مِنْهُ أَحَدًا لِمُوَافَاةِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim said: Hudba informed us. He said: Sulaymān b. al-Mughīra narrated to us, from Thābit, who said:
records.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ would fall ill and recover; and when he fell ill [p. 60] with the illness in which he died, he said: “I do not see this except as that from which God will leave no one out, so that [all] may arrive at the Day of Resurrection.”
translator_notes: Thābit reports this without naming a Companion. The last clause is obscure and the rendering is tentative.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: عَادَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرِيضًا، فَجَعَلَ يَصْرِفُ وَجْهَهُ عَنْهُ، فَإِذَا نَظَرَ إِلَيْهِ تَغَيَّرَ لَوْنُهُ، فَإِذَا صَرَفَ وَجْهَهُ تَغَيَّرَ لَوْنُهُ، قَالَ: «فَطِنْتُمْ لِي؟» قَالُوا: نَعَمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: ‌ ‌«مَا مِنْهُ مِنْ عِرْقٍ إِلَّا يَأْلَمُ، وَلَقَدْ أَتَاهُ آتٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِ فَبَشَّرَهُ أَنَّهُ لَا أَدَبَ عَلَيْهِ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Sulaymān narrated to us, from Thābit, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ visited a sick man, and he kept turning his face away from him; when he looked at him his colour changed, and when he turned his face away his colour changed. He said: “Have you noticed me?” They said: Yes, O Messenger of God. He said: “There is no vein in him but it aches; and one has come to him from his Lord and given him the glad tidings that there is no ‘adab’ upon him.”
translator_notes: Thābit reports this without naming a Companion. The sense of ‘no adab upon him’ (discipline, correction) is uncertain and the text may be corrupt.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ غَيْلَانَ بْنِ جَرِيرٍ، قَالَ:‌ ‌
records.matn_ar: كَانَ مُسْلِمُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ إِذَا صَلَّى كَأَنَّهُ ثَوْبٌ مُلْقًى، مِنْ قِلَّةِ الْتِفَاتِهِ "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Sulaymān narrated to us, from Ghaylān b. Jarīr, who said:
records.matn_en: Muslim b. Yasār, when he prayed, was like a garment cast down, from how little he turned about.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: " بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ الرَّجُلَ يَتَّكِئُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ سَبْعِينَ سَنَةً، عِنْدَهُ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِهِ وَخَدَمِهِ وَمَا أَعْطَاهُ اللَّهُ مِنَ الْكَرَامَةِ وَالنَّعِيمِ، فَإِذَا حَانَتْ مِنْهُ نَظْرَةٌ إِذَا أَزْوَاجٌ لَهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ رَآهُنَّ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ يَقُلْنَ: قَدْ‌ ‌ آنَ لَكَ أَنْ ⦗ص: 61⦘ تَجْعَلَ لَنَا مِنْكَ نَصِيبًا "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Sulaymān narrated to us, from Thābit, who said:
records.matn_en: “It has reached us that a man will recline in Paradise for seventy years, with his wives and servants and the honour and delight God has given him; then, when a glance of his falls elsewhere, there are wives of his whom he had not seen before, saying: It is time for you [p. 61] to give us a share of yourself.”
translator_notes: ‘It has reached us’ marks a report without a chain.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قِيلَ لَهُ: هَذَا الْمُؤْمِنُ يُشَدَّدُ عَلَيْهِ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ، وَهَذَا الْكَافِرُ يُهَوَّنُ عَلَيْهِ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ؟ قَالَ: ‌ ‌«أَفَلَا أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَنْ ذَلِكَ؟ إِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ يَبْقَى عَلَيْهِ ذُنُوبٌ لَيُكَافَأُ بِهَا عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ، وَإِنَّ الْكَافِرَ تَبْقَى لَهُ حَسَنَاتٌ فَيُجْزَى بِهَا عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Hammām narrated to us, from Qatāda, from al-Ḥasan, that the Prophet ﷺ was told:
records.matn_en: This believer has it made hard for him at death, while this unbeliever has it made easy for him at death? He said: “Shall I not tell you about that? The believer has sins remaining upon him for which he is repaid at his death; and the unbeliever has good deeds remaining to him, for which he is recompensed at his death.”
translator_notes: Al-Ḥasan reports this without naming a Companion.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبِ بْنِ ⦗ص: 62⦘ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ هِلَالِ بْنِ أَبِي زَيْنَبَ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُخْتَارِ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِابْنِ صَائِدٍ: ‌ ‌«مَا تُرْبَةُ الْجَنَّةِ يَا ابْنَ صَائِدٍ؟» قَالَ: دَرْمَكَةٌ بَيْضَاءُ مِسْكٌ يَا أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ، قَالَ: «صَدَقَ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: al-Ḥasan b. Maḥbūb b. [p. 62] al-Ḥasan b. Hilāl b. Abī Zaynab narrated to us. He said: ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. al-Mukhtār narrated to us. He said: Abū Maslama narrated to us, from Abū Naḍra, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, that the Prophet ﷺ said to Ibn Ṣāʾid:
records.matn_en: “What is the soil of Paradise, Ibn Ṣāʾid?” He said: White fine flour (darmaka), musk, O Abū al-Qāsim. He said: “He has spoken truly.”

narrators.en: al-Ḥasan b. Maḥbūb b. al-Ḥasan b. Hilāl b. Abī Zaynab

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو تُمَيْلَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ: ‌ ‌{اعْمَلُوا آلَ دَاوُدَ شُكْرًا} ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: «الشُّكْرُ تَقْوَى اللَّهِ، وَالْعَمَلُ بِطَاعَتِهِ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Muḥammad b. Saʿīd b. al-Walīd narrated to us. He said: Abū Tumayla narrated to us, from Mūsā b. ʿUbayda, from Muḥammad b. Kaʿb:
records.matn_en: {Work, O family of David, in gratitude} [Q. 34:13]. He said: “Gratitude is God-fearing piety (taqwā) and acting in obedience to Him.”
translator_notes: The source quotes the verse without a reference; Q. 34:13 is supplied by the translator.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ الْقُطَعِيُّ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو تُمَيْلَةَ، عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ وَاقِدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ النَّحْوِيِّ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ: ‌
records.matn_ar: ‌{يَعْلَمُونَ ظَاهِرًا مِنَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا} [الروم: 7] قَالَ: مَتَى يَزْرَعُونَ، وَمَتَى يَغْرِسُونَ، وَمَتَى يَحْصُدُونَ ، وَأَشْبَاهَ ذَلِكَ "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Abū Bakr al-Quṭaʿī Muḥammad b. Saʿīd narrated to us. He said: Abū Tumayla narrated to us, from al-Ḥusayn b. Wāqid, from Yazīd al-Naḥwī, from ʿIkrima, from Ibn ʿAbbās:
records.matn_en: {They know what is apparent of the life of this world} [Q. 30:7]. He said: “[They know] when to sow, when to plant, when to reap, and the like.”

narrators.en: Abū Bakr al-Quṭaʿī Muḥammad b. Saʿīd

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ اللَّاحِقِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ: ‌
records.matn_ar: ‌{يَعْلَمُونَ ظَاهِرًا مِنَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا} [الروم: 7] الْآيَةَ، فَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ: «وَاللَّهِ لَبَلَغَ مِنْ عِلْمِ أَحَدِهِمْ مِنْ دُنْيَاهُ أَنَّهُ يُقَلِّبُ الدِّرْهَمَ عَلَى ظُفْرِهِ يُخْبِرُكَ بِوَزْنِهِ، مَا يُحْسِنُ يُصَلِّي»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: ʿAlī b. ʿUthmān al-Lāḥiqī narrated to us. He said: Juwayriya b. Bashīr narrated to us, from al-Ḥasan:
records.matn_en: {They know what is apparent of the life of this world} [Q. 30:7]—the verse [continues]. Then al-Ḥasan said: “By God, the worldly knowledge of one of them reaches the point that he turns a dirham over on his fingernail and tells you its weight, [yet] he does not know how to pray properly.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَفْصٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ هُوَ أَبُو طُوَالَةَ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ بِهَدِيَّةٍ، فَطَلَبَ فِي الْبَيْتِ شَيْئًا يَضَعُهَا فِيهِ، فَلَمْ يَجِدْهُ، فَقَالَ: ‌ ‌«ضَعْهَا بِالْحَضِيضِ، فَلَوْ كَانَتْ تَعْدِلُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ جَنَاحَ بَعُوضَةٍ مَا سَقَى مِنْهَا كَافِرًا شَرْبَةً»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Abū Ḥafṣ narrated to us. He said: Abū ʿĀṣim narrated to us. He said: Muḥammad b. ʿUmāra b. ʿAmr b. Ḥazm narrated to us, from ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān—he is Abū Ṭuwāla—that the Prophet ﷺ was brought a gift, and he looked in the house for something to put it in, but did not find it. He said:
records.matn_en: “Put it on the ground (al-ḥaḍīḍ); for if it were worth to God the wing of a gnat, He would not have given a disbeliever a single drink from it.”

narrators.en: Muḥammad b. ʿUmāra b. ʿAmr b. Ḥazm
ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Abū Ṭuwāla)

translator_notes: Abū Ṭuwāla reports this without naming a Companion. In the second clause ‘it’ is feminine, like ‘the gift’ (hadiyya); in other versions of the saying the referent is ‘the world’ (al-dunyā), which may be what is meant here.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي ⦗ص: 64⦘ صَالِحُ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ: ‌
records.matn_ar: ‌«لَئِنْ أُؤْتَمَنُ عَلَى بَيْتٍ مِنْ دُرٍّ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أُؤْتَمَنَ عَلَى امْرَأَةٍ حَسْنَاءَ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to me. He said: [p. 64] Ṣāliḥ b. Mūsā narrated to me, from Muʿāwiya b. Isḥāq, from Saʿīd b. Jubayr, who said:
records.matn_en: “To be entrusted with a house of pearls is dearer to me than to be entrusted with a beautiful woman.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُحَيَّاةِ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَعْلَى، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قِيلَ لِأَبِي وَائِلٍ: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى خَارِجِيٍّ خَرَجَ عَلَى النَّاسِ فِي السُّوقِ، فَعَدَا عَلَيْهِ أَهْلُ السُّوقِ، فَضَرَبُوهُ بِالْكَرَاسِيِّ حَتَّى قَتَلُوهُ؟ فَقَالَ أَبُو وَائِلٍ: وَاللَّهِ‌ ‌ مَا عَزَّ هَذَا لِلَّهِ دِينًا، وَلَا رَدَّ مَظْلِمَةَ مَظْلُومٍ، هَذَا وَأَبِيكَ الْحُسَيْنُ "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to me. He said: Abū al-Muḥayyāt Yaḥyā b. Yaʿlā narrated to us, from ʿAbd al-Malik b. ʿUmayr, who said:
records.matn_en: Abū Wāʾil was told: Have you not seen the Khārijī who came out against the people in the market, so the people of the market rushed upon him and struck him with chairs until they killed him? Abū Wāʾil said: “By God, this man neither strengthened any religion for God nor redressed the grievance of any wronged person. This one, by your father, is al-Ḥusayn.”
translator_notes: The last sentence is obscure: ‘al-Ḥusayn’ may be the name of the man killed or an allusion to al-Ḥusayn b. ʿAlī. The rendering is literal and tentative.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الْمُحَيَّاةِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: قَالَ رَجُلٌ لِابْنِهِ: «يَا بُنَيَّ،‌ ‌ أَظْهِرِ الْإِيَاسَ مِمَّا عِنْدَ النَّاسِ؛ فَإِنَّهُ الْغِنَى، وَإِيَّاكَ وَطَلَبَ الْحَوَائِجِ إِلَيْهِمْ؛ فَإِنَّهُ فَقْرٌ حَاضِرٌ، وَإِذَا قُمْتَ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ فَأَحْسِنِ الْوُضُوءَ ثُمَّ صَلِّ صَلَاةَ مُوَدِّعٍ، فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تَكُونَ الْيَوْمَ خَيْرًا مِنْكَ أَمْسِ، وَغَدًا خَيْرًا مِنْكَ الْيَوْمَ، فَافْعَلْ، وَإِيَّاكَ وَمَا يُعْتَذَرُ مِنْهُ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd b. Saʿīd narrated to me. He said: Abū al-Muḥayyāt narrated to me, from ʿAbd al-Malik b. ʿUmayr, who said:
records.matn_en: A man said to his son: “My son, show despair of what people have, for that is wealth; and beware of seeking your needs from them, for that is present poverty. When you stand to pray, perform the ablution well, then pray the prayer of one bidding farewell. If you are able to be better today than you were yesterday, and better tomorrow than you are today, then do so. And beware of anything for which one must apologize.”
translator_notes: The man is not named.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُطَّلِبُ ⦗ص: 66⦘ يَعْنِي ابْنَ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَدَرِيَّةِ فَقَالَ: يَا أَبَا الْحُسَيْنِ،‌ ‌ أَسْأَلُكَ عَنْ كَلِمَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ، قَالَ: أَحَبَّ اللَّهُ تبارك وتعالى أَنْ يُعْصَى؟ قَالَ زَيْدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ: فَعُصِيَ عَنْوَةً؟ قَالَ: فَاشْتَدَّ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ يَهْرُبُ "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to me. He said: al-Muṭṭalib [p. 66]—meaning Ibn Ziyād—narrated to us, from Zayd b. ʿAlī, who said:
records.matn_en: A man of the Qadariyya came to him and said: O Abū al-Ḥusayn, I ask you about one word. He said: “Did God love to be disobeyed?” Zayd b. ʿAlī said: “Then was He disobeyed by force?” He said: And the man bolted from before him, fleeing.
translator_notes: The speaker of ‘Did God love to be disobeyed?’ is the Qadarī; the source does not mark the change of speaker.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَرْوَانَ الْبَصْرِيُّ، عَنْ كَثِيرٍ أَبِي الْفَضْلِ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ: ‌
records.matn_ar: ‌«قُتِلَ مِنْ عَلِيٍّ وَمُعَاوِيَةَ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا يَوْمَ صِفِّينَ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to me. He said: Muḥammad b. Marwān al-Baṣrī narrated to us, from Kathīr Abū al-Faḍl, from al-Shaʿbī, who said:
records.matn_en: “Seventy thousand were killed from [the forces of] ʿAlī and Muʿāwiya on the day of Ṣiffīn.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ، يَقُولُ:
records.matn_ar: "‌ ‌ الْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ فِي هَذَيْنِ الْحَرْفَيْنِ: الْأَخْذُ بِمَا أُمِرْتُمْ، وَالنَّهْيُ عَمَّا نُهِيتُمْ عَنْهُ "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to us. He said: Muḥammad b. ʿUmar narrated to us. He said: I heard al-Ḥasan say:
records.matn_en: “All good lies in these two words: taking up what you have been commanded, and abstaining from what you have been forbidden.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كُنَّا مَعَ الْحَسَنِ، فَوَقَفَ عَلَى قَبْرٍ فَقَالَ: «أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ،‌ ‌ عَيْشُ هَذَا آخِرُهُ، مَا خَيْرٌ فِي أَوَّلِهِ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to me. He said: Fuḍayl b. ʿIyāḍ narrated to us, from Hishām b. Ḥassān, who said:
records.matn_en: We were with al-Ḥasan, and he stopped at a grave and said: “O people, a life whose end is this—what good is there in its beginning?”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ الرَّازِيِّ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كُنَّا عِنْدَ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيِّ، فَكَانَ‌ ‌ إِذَا أَتَاهُ الرَّجُلُ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ سَأَلَهُ: هَلْ لَكَ وَجْهُ مَعِيشَةٍ؟ فَإِنْ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ فِي كِفَايَةٍ أَمَرَهُ بِطَلَبِ الْعِلْمِ ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِي كِفَايَةٍ أَمَرَهُ بِطَلَبِ الْمَعَاشِ "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to me, from ʿAbd al-Raḥīm b. Sulaymān al-Rāzī, who said:
records.matn_en: We were with Sufyān al-Thawrī, and whenever a man came to him seeking knowledge he would ask him: Do you have a means of livelihood? If he told him that he was provided for, he would command him to seek knowledge; and if he was not provided for, he would command him to seek a livelihood.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوْنٍ الْحَكَمُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: مَكْتُوبٌ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ: ‌ ‌«كَمَا تَدِينُ تُدَانُ، وَكَمَا تَزْرَعُ تَحْصُدُ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to me. He said: Abū ʿAwn al-Ḥakam b. Sinān narrated to us, from Mālik b. Dīnār, who said:
records.matn_en: It is written in the Torah: “As you deal, so shall you be dealt with; and as you sow, so shall you reap.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ النِّيلِيُّ، بِالرَّحَبَةِ رَحَبَةِ طَوْقٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ: ‌ ‌
records.matn_ar: «مَا كَذَبْتُ مُنْذُ شَدَدْتُ عَلَيَّ إِزَارِي»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to me. He said: Muḥammad b. Khālid al-Nīlī narrated to me, in al-Raḥaba—Raḥabat Ṭawq. He said: al-Walīd b. Muslim narrated to us, from Mālik b. Anas, who said: ʿUmar b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz said:
records.matn_en: “I have not lied since I tightened my waistcloth (izār) upon me.”
translator_notes: The phrase is probably an idiom for reaching maturity; it is rendered literally.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، عَنْ ثَوْرٍ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: "‌ ‌ مَنْ حَدَّثَ النَّاسَ بِمَا رَأَتْهُ عَيْنَاهُ، أَوْ سَمِعَتْ أُذُنَاهُ، أَوْ أَخَذَتْهُ يَدَاهُ، فَهُوَ مِنَ {الَّذِينَ يُحِبُّونَ أَنْ تَشِيعَ الْفَاحِشَةُ فِي الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا} [النور: 19] "
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Muḥammad narrated to us. He said: al-Walīd narrated to us, from Thawr, from Khālid b. Maʿdān, who said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever tells people what his two eyes have seen, or his two ears have heard, or his two hands have taken, is among {those who love that indecency should spread among those who believe} [Q. 24:19].”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، قَالَ: نا الْوَلِيدُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ بَعْضَ السَّلَفِ قَالَ لِرَقِيقٍ لَهُ، وَقَدْ ضَاقَ فِي بَعْضِ الْأَمْرِ: ‌ ‌«إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تُغَيِّرَ خُلُقَكَ بِأَحْسَنَ فَافْعَلْ، وَإِلَّا فَيَسَعُكَ مِنْ أَخْلَاقِنَا مَا ضَاقَ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ خُلُقِكَ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to me. He said: Muḥammad narrated to me. He said: al-Walīd narrated to us, from Saʿīd b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz:
records.matn_en: That one of the Salaf said to a slave of his who had become hard-pressed in some matter: “If you are able to change your character for something better, do so; and if not, then of our dispositions there is room for what has become narrow for you in your own disposition.”
translator_notes: The last clause is terse and the rendering is tentative.

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَاتِكَةِ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَبَا مُسْلِمٍ الْخَوْلَانِيَّ اشْتَرَى بَغْلَةً، فَقَالَتْ لَهُ امْرَأَتُهُ:‌ ‌ ادْعُ اللَّهَ لَنَا فِيهَا بِالْبَرَكَةِ، قَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهَا» ، فَأَصْبَحَتْ وَقَدْ نَفَقَتْ. ثُمَّ اشْتَرَى بَغْلَةً ثَانِيَةً، فَقَالَتْ لَهُ مِثْلَهَا، فَأَصْبَحَتْ وَقَدْ نَفَقَتْ. ثُمَّ اشْتَرَى الثَّالِثَةَ، فَقَالَتْ: أَبَا مُسْلِمٍ، ادْعُ اللَّهَ لَنَا فِيهَا بِالْبَرَكَةِ، فَقَالَ: «اسْكُتِي يَا حَمْقَاءُ، اللَّهُمَّ مَتِّعْنَا بِهَا»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Muḥammad narrated to me. He said: al-Walīd narrated to us, from ʿUthmān b. Abī al-ʿĀtika:
records.matn_en: That Abū Muslim al-Khawlānī bought a mule, and his wife said to him: Pray to God for blessing for us in it. He said: “O God, bless us in it.” But in the morning it had died. Then he bought a second mule, and she said the like of that to him; and in the morning it had died. Then he bought a third, and she said: Abū Muslim, pray to God for blessing for us in it. He said: “Be quiet, you foolish woman! O God, let us enjoy it.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، عَنِ ابْنِ جَابِرٍ،
records.matn_ar: سَمِعَ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُخَيْمِرَةَ،‌ ‌ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَقُولَ لَهُ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ إِخْوَانِهِ: أَمْتَعَ اللَّهُ بِكَ، قَالَ: «إِنَّمَا هِيَ دَعْوَةٌ مُحْدَثَةٌ»
records.isnad_en: Abū Ḥātim narrated to us. He said: Muḥammad narrated to me. He said: al-Walīd narrated to us, from Ibn Jābir; he heard al-Qāsim b. Mukhaymira
records.matn_en: disliking that one of his brothers should say to him: “May God let you enjoy [a long life] (amtaʿa Allāhu bika).” He said: “It is only a newly introduced supplication.”

records.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ،
